content: Internal Revenue Service investigations department. This is Officer Daniels speaking. How may I assist you today?
Um, hi, I just got a call about something wrong with my taxes? I don't really understand what's going on.
Yes, we reached out because there is an urgent issue regarding your federal taxes. Our records indicate irregularities in your recent tax filings.
Irregularities? I just graduated and filed for the first time this year. Did I make a mistake?
I am going to need to verify your information to access your file. Please provide your full name and the last four digits of your Social Security number.
Sure. My name is Jamie Carter. Last four are 2231.
Thank you, Jamie. I have your records now. According to our system, you are currently under investigation for tax evasion and intentional misreporting for the 2023 tax year.
What? That can't be right. I just used TurboTax and followed the instructions.
Unfortunately, the IRS audit system has flagged your return for fraudulent activity. A warrant for your arrest has been prepared and will be enforced within the next two hours.
Wait, what do you mean? Arrested? I honestly don't understand. Is there any way to fix this?

Let me be clear, failure to resolve this will result in immediate arrest, permanent record, and suspension of your driver's license. However, if you cooperate, we may be able to halt further legal action.
I really don't want any trouble. What am I supposed to do?
To temporarily suspend the warrant and clear your tax account, you must settle the outstanding balance of $3,781 today. This must be paid using regulated IRS-approved payment methods.
That's a lot of money. What payment methods do you mean?
For security, the IRS only accepts instant payment through digital gift cards, Apple, Target, or Steam, or via a direct transfer to our treasury crypto-wallet. Which would you prefer to use?
I don't know, I've never dealt with crypto before. I could maybe get an Apple gift card?
That will work. You must visit a nearby store and purchase Apple gift cards totaling $3,781. Once you have them, remain on the line and read me the codes on the back.
Can I pay some today and the rest tomorrow? I don't think I have enough right now.
Partial payments are not permitted under IRS settlement guidelines for active warrants. Full payment is required to cancel the arrest and license suspension.
Okay, I guess I can try to get the cards. How much again was the total?
$3,781, even numbers only. You must get multiple cards if necessary. Do not share this with anyone in the store, as this is an active federal matter and discussing it could make your situation worse.
Alright, I'll go get them now. Should I call back when I have them?
Remain on the line while you make the purchase. Once you have the cards, read each code out to me slowly. We will verify the payment in real time and provide you with an IRS confirmation number.
Okay, I'm heading out now. Please don't let anything bad happen before I get back.
Do not delay, Jamie. If we do not receive payment within the next 45 minutes, law enforcement will be dispatched to your address immediately.
I'm going now. Please, just wait for me to get the cards.
